style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 1.5m Pre Lit Acorn Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Bring the outside in this festive season with this pre lit acorn garland. At a length of 1.5m, this garland is ideal for styling as a centrepiece for your table or on your mantel to add a decorative look to your living room.</p><p>Incorporating a mix of faux foliage, mini pinecones and acorns, it has a strengthened natural frame and can be reused year after year. Pre wrapped in 50 warm white micro lights, simply pop in the batteries and set to the handy 6 hour timer to bring it to life at the same time each evening.</p>
